title: System & Network Booster
tips: Booster order: measure (ping / networkQuality) → flush DNS → disable leftover proxies → optional public DNS → Wi-Fi power cycle → renew DHCP last.
Self-assigned 169.254.x.x almost always means DHCP failed — renew the lease before chasing DNS.
Leftover HTTP/HTTPS proxies after VPN disconnect block apps that never show a clear error — disable proxies on the active service.
Prefer allowlisted one-click fixes in Fix Happens over pasting shell commands from the web.
networkQuality -s is read-only and a good before/after check when applying boost steps.
